title: Mecca Joint Deterrence Agreement: Implications for India
author: Dinakar Peri
text:
Turkish President Erdogan, Saudi Crown Prince and Prime Minister Mohammed bin Salman and Pakistani Prime Minister Shehbaz Sharif hold copies of the Mecca Agreement after its signing on August 7, 2026.
Credit: Facebook/Shehbaz Sharif Updates
On August 7, Saudi Arabia, Pakistan and Turkiye concluded the Mecca Joint Deterrence Agreement to strengthen “collective deterrence” against any act of aggression. The agreement states that an armed attack against “any one of the three states shall be regarded as an attack against them all.”Signed in the holy city of Mecca by Saudi Crown Prince and Prime Minister Mohammed bin Salman, Turkish President Recep Tayyip Erdogan and Pakistani Prime Minister Shehbaz Sharif, the pact expands the bilateral Strategic Mutual Defense Agreement (SMDA) between Riyadh and Islamabad signed in September 2025, to include Turkiye.[...]
